description: T4: the 14 degenerate Ed25519 keys (8 small-order, 2 sign-bit aliases of x = 0, 4 non-canonical y + p) as an address record's key, a hop's iss and an envelope's from, with R the identity and S = 0 over an arbitrary digest and one ground so that k = 0 mod 8: bad-record-sig, bad-hop-sig, bad-sig. Keys of mixed order ([a]B plus each point of order 8) signing with a: ok when k = 0 mod 8, bad-*-sig otherwise (spec/SPEC.md §2.3). A genuine key in each place as the control. Round 2: each case's expected verdict is the one pre-registered for its line, not the TypeScript core's (spec/adversarial/README.md, "Round 2").
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
